purpose: corpus-level aggregate questions — graph RAG decision gate (docs/graphrag_research.md)

questions.question: Which papers in this collection mention the MTEB benchmark (Massive Text Embedding Benchmark) anywhere in their text, including references? List all of them.
questions.answer: Exactly 7 papers: ColPali (rp001), VisRAG (rp002), RAG Survey (rp009), Qwen3 Embedding (rp014), NV-Embed (rp015), Gecko (rp017), Nomic Embed (rp018). Notes for grading: rp001 (ColPali) mentions MTEB only as a bibliography entry (p14); rp002 (VisRAG) mentions it in passing (p8) plus a reference (p13); rp009 (RAG Survey) discusses the MTEB leaderboard (p9). The four embedding papers rp014, rp015, rp017, rp018 evaluate on MTEB extensively. Accept also: answers using full paper titles, or counting variants like 'C-MTEB'/'MTEB Multilingual' (both contain the string MTEB and occur only in already-listed papers). BGE-M3 (rp016) does NOT mention MTEB and must not be listed.

questions.question: How many of the 25 papers in this collection mention the HotpotQA dataset anywhere in their text (including references and dataset lists)? Give the count.
questions.answer: 10 papers. They are: GraphRAG (From Local to Global) (rp008), RAG Survey (rp009), Speculative RAG (rp010), RankRAG (rp011), Qwen3 Embedding (rp014), NV-Embed (rp015), BGE-M3 (rp016), Gecko (rp017), Nomic Embed (rp018), Reflexion (rp019). Accept '10' with or without the list; if a list is given it must match this set. Spelling variants HotpotQA/HotPotQA/Hotpotqa and hyphen/line-break splits all count.

questions.question: Self-RAG is one of the papers in this collection. Which OTHER papers in the collection mention Self-RAG by name anywhere in their text (including references)?
questions.answer: Exactly 5 papers: VisRAG (rp002), CRAG (Corrective RAG) (rp005), RAG Survey (rp009), Speculative RAG (rp010), RankRAG (rp011). Notes for grading: rp002 (VisRAG)'s only mention is a bibliography entry citing the Self-RAG paper (p11); rp005 (CRAG) implements/compares against Self-RAG extensively; rp009 (RAG Survey) discusses it; rp010 (Speculative RAG) and rp011 (RankRAG) compare against it as a baseline. Accept also: 'Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation' for CRAG, 'Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: A Survey' for the RAG Survey. Self-RAG (rp004) itself must not be counted.

questions.question: Considering the four benchmark datasets MS MARCO, Natural Questions (NQ), HotpotQA, and TriviaQA: which one is mentioned by the largest number of papers in this collection (counting any mention, including references and training-data lists), and by how many papers?
questions.answer: MS MARCO, mentioned by 12 of the 25 papers: ColPali (rp001), Document Screenshot Embedding (DSE) (rp003), Self-RAG (rp004), RAG Survey (rp009), Speculative RAG (rp010), RankRAG (rp011), Lost in the Middle (rp012), Qwen3 Embedding (rp014), NV-Embed (rp015), BGE-M3 (rp016), Gecko (rp017), Nomic Embed (rp018). The comparison counts are: MS MARCO 12, Natural Questions 10 (rp003, rp004, rp009, rp011, rp012, rp014, rp015, rp016, rp017, rp018), HotpotQA 10 (rp008, rp009, rp010, rp011, rp014, rp015, rp016, rp017, rp018, rp019), TriviaQA 7 (rp003, rp004, rp009, rp010, rp011, rp013, rp016). Accept 'MS MARCO' (also spelled MSMARCO/MS-MARCO/MSMarco) with count 12; the count is the load-bearing part together with the dataset name.

questions.question: Several papers in this collection train their retrieval or embedding models partly on SYNTHETIC training data generated by an LLM or VLM (i.e., model-generated queries or query-document/text pairs used to train the retriever/embedder). Name at least three such papers.
questions.answer: RUBRIC: must name at least 3 of these 6 papers: ColPali (rp001: 37% of its training set is synthetic pages with VLM-generated Claude-3 Sonnet pseudo-questions, p6), VisRAG (rp002: GPT-4o-generated queries over web-crawled PDFs to train the retriever, p5/p17), Qwen3 Embedding (rp014: large-scale synthetic pairs synthesized with Qwen3-32B, p5-p6), NV-Embed (rp015: synthetic data generation as part of its embedding training-data recipe, p1-p2), BGE-M3 (rp016: synthetic long-document question-answer pairs generated with GPT-3.5 [MultiLongDoc], p3/p14), Gecko (rp017: FRet two-step distillation, LLM-generated synthetic paired data, p1/p3-p4). Do NOT accept: Nomic Embed or DSE (no synthetic training data mentioned); RankRAG (its 'synthetic conversations' are LLM instruction-tuning data, not retriever training pairs); Speculative RAG (synthesizes rationales to train a drafter LM, not a retriever); Self-RAG (uses off-the-shelf Contriever; GPT-4-distilled data trains the critic LM); Lost in the Middle (synthetic key-value task is an evaluation task); Qwen2-VL/Qwen2.5-VL/InternVL/DeepSeek-R1 (synthetic data mentioned for general model pre-training, not retrieval).
